barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.description: Boards on the windows, junk in the doorways.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Spot trouble two days out instead of one.

fortified_walls.name: Fortified Walls
fortified_walls.description: Real walls. Took the doors off three houses.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
infirmary.description: Beds, boiled water, what's left of the medkits.

armory.name: Armory
armory.description: Organized weapons. People know where the ammo is.

trap_field.name: Trap Field
trap_field.description: Spikes, snares, fall pits. They walk in. They don't walk out.

generator.name: Generator
generator.description: Lights. A radio. The first time someone laughs in a month.

radio_tower.name: Radio Tower
radio_tower.description: Hear them coming. Maybe call for help. Maybe be heard.

bunker.name: Bunker
bunker.description: Reinforced concrete and steel. The megahorde might not be the end.
